India rejects Pakistan minister's remarks on Indus Waters Treaty

India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has rejected statements made by a Pakistani minister regarding the Indus Waters Treaty. The Pakistani minister's remarks were perceived as threatening war over the treaty. The MEA's response asserts India's position on the matter.
